coverage_note: Uses completed annual OOS CSVs for 2022 partial, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026 partial. Decisions for a month use only previous calendar months.

rules.baseline_no_prior_defense: No monthly defense; all combo weights stay at base allocation.
rules.strategy_half_after_prior_month_loss: For each strategy, halve next-month weight if that strategy lost money in the previous calendar month.
rules.strategy_skip_after_prior_month_loss: For each strategy, set next-month weight to zero if that strategy lost money in the previous calendar month.
rules.strategy_skip_after_prior_month_loss_500: For each strategy, set next-month weight to zero if that strategy lost at least 500,000 KRW in the previous calendar month.
rules.strategy_half_after_two_month_cum_loss: For each strategy, halve next-month weight if its previous two calendar months sum below zero.
rules.combo_half_after_prior_month_loss: For the whole combo, halve all member weights if the prior month combo PnL was negative.
